nom: Earth Therapeutics Hydrogel Under-Eye Recovery Patch

avis.titre: I've been using these for years!
avis.texte: I just read some bad reviews about this product which i don't get. I have been using these for a long time. I do not get wrinkles after use. I wouldn't say it helps my dark circles. I personally don't think anything I've tried does, but my undereyes feel very hydrated after having these on! I have been getting dry skin underneath my eyes and these have seemed to help a little + they do not burn. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Best product, my better than others by far
avis.texte: They work, they feel amazing, I will always use these and no others

These are my go to under eye patches! They stick on and do not slide and you go from looking tired and worn out, to refreshed! I absolutely love them and I have sensitive skin. They do not mess with me at all.
I love these they work great they feel wonderful. I haven't had any negative side effects. I was looking for something with good ingredients that smelled good and wasn't too harsh.

avis.titre: Must buy for under your eyes
avis.texte: I have been using these daily for years. They are hypoallergenic, actually work to de-puff/help dark circles, feels refreshing, smell like cucumbers and is Korean made, whoohoo!
I bought these just to try out. I use them after getting my lashes done to help with any puffiness. Works very well refreshes my eyes cool sensation feeling will definitely recommend these.
These are amazing! Take away the tired eyes, bags. They stay put, no sliding and are great for my sensitive skin too! Absolutely my favorite!
Hydrogel is calming on your under eye and your enjoy the smooth results.

avis.titre: Preferred Earth Therapeutics Cucumber Eye Pad
avis.texte: I was an avid user of Earth Therapeutics' Recover-E cucumber eye pads , and was disheartened to find that Ulta doesn't seem to sell them anymore. I have tried this under eye pad. Please note I always keep them in the refrigerator for additional cooling. While the eye patch under the eye is fairly easy to use and applies well, the former circular patches would cover the entire eye and seemed to tighten and lift way better. With this patch being under the eye, the top of the eye does not get the same treatment without using an additional patch, which is pointless. I have not seen nearly the same result, using this under your eye pad and will move on.

Just returned for my second purchase. I found this very hydrating and particularly like the way they stay put when placed under my eyes. I have tried pricier versions, and actually like these better. Would love a higher count package.

These undereye eye gels work great! They are gentle, cucumber-fragrant, & easy to put on. I was a little confused as to why the sticky side would go on the undereye, but then discovered that the gel is on the sticky side for better contact. Probably not a good idea to leave on more than 30 mins., as sticky side is kind of hard to remove gently. Still good, affordable product, though.

I really love these eye patches. Been buying them for years now. I find them to be even better than the more expensive eye patches on the market because they actually stay in place and they're not gooey. I notice an immediate depuffing effect and the skin under my eyes feels more hydrated. They smell like cucumber and tea. I love the scent!
I really love these rte patches! By far the best ive used and great for sensitive skin!
These are the best product ET has IMO. I have hollow under eyes and i look like i have fillers after 20 minutes of use. Wears off theoughout the day like any other patch but still worth it

avis.titre: I've been a fan for years! These are awesome.
avis.texte: Started using these in 2019 when I noticed a dry spot under one of my eyes and have used them regularly since then. This is a staple of my skincare regimen and make my undereyes look & feel amazing. For reference, I'm 40 w/sensitive skin.

These patches really do wonders. I woke up with super puffy under eyes and I applied these on my eyes and after 30 minutes, my eyes looked so much more refreshed and awake. The puffiness definitely went down as well. I put these in my mini skincare fridge for that extra cooling effect and they feel sooo good once you apply them on. I will definitely be buying more of these.

avis.titre: One of my favorite products from ULTA
avis.texte: I absolutely love these hydrogel under eye patches and so many of the other products by Earth Therapeutics. I have bought several boxes to add to care packages I have made for my friends and family who work in healthcare, others with chronic illnesses like myself and those who have become new moms during the pandemic. They all love them too. The patches are so easy to use. I'm able to put them on easily and not worry about them falling off no matter what I do. After showering/washing my face- I put on my facial lotion and simply skip the area for the patches, put on the patches and leave them on while I can continue on with whatever I need to do. It's normally time to remove the patches by the time I finish my hair and there is a significant difference in the puffiness and an increased brightness under my eyes. I also love the subtle cucumber smell. As someone with chronic illnesses this is such a simple act of self care that I can do for myself that helps me feel and look more human, especially after a long night of feeling unwell. It also has an easy clean up so I don't have to worry about using more energy. I have long list of allergies along with very sensitive skin but I have no issues with these patches at all! They are definitely worth the price and even more so when they are on sale.

I just recently started using it, so I don't know how well it works. I enjoy the ease of using it and it stays on while I'm doing things around the house. It feels nice under the eyes, a cool feeling.
I love the feel and results. My under eye area looks refreshed and has a glow after using the patches. The only downside is that it takes 30 min. I will purchase more and continue to use!

I brought these unsure if they would work or not but for the price I wouldn't have lost much. I didn't realize they had cucumber in them but I wanted cucumber so it was a win for me. The smell was relaxing and they stayed in place. I can't tell how well it works yet but I would purchase again solely for how it relaxed my eyes and skin

i've been using these for a while, at least a year. i've used all sorts of eye patches but always come back to these. they're cheap, you actually see a difference even after one use, i literally just wish the outside of them were cuter lol

i've been using these for a while, at least a year. i've used all sorts of eye patches but always come back to these. they're cheap, you actually see a difference even after one use, i literally just wish the outside of them were cuter lol
I absolutely love these under eye patches! They stay put where you place them because they have a stickiness to them. They hydrate very well, remove easily and left my under eye area soft.
I started a night shift job so my bags under my eyes have been black, i got these and used it 2 times already and its made a difference!

These are just ok. They have great ingredients and the patches adhere well to under eye area but after 20 minutes I felt like they were drying my under eye area more than hydrating them. Not very soothing overall. Would not repurchase.

I love that these have a cloth backing and a gel application side so the patch stays in place without any "goop." They feel amazing, are gentle to remove, and leave my under eyes looking great immediately after!
These eye patches work nicely and feel great on my skin. However, in the box I have two packages that have only had one patch in each.

I wore these longer than the 30 minutes direction. They were easy to apply, stayed put where they were placed, had a wonderful cooling effect that isn't too cooling and best of all I smell is cucumber. which is one of my all time favorite smells. This was a 5 star product for me as soon as I used 1 pair. Will definitely be repurchasing.
Maybe one in the whole pack didn't slide all the way down my face, but all the rest did. They would feel nice, but ugh so frustrating.
LITERALLY GAVE ME UNDER EYE WRINKLES… NEVER HAD THEM BEFORE. FIRST TIME AND LAST TIME. ABSOLUTELY HORRIFIED

I purchased these for the first time about two weeks ago, and I have to say I'm pleasantly surprised. I wasn't expecting too much, but these things are amazing. They have the perfect amount of stickiness to them, but not so much so that they're hard on your skin. They have a tiny scent to them, but it's a fresh relaxing cucumber scent, nothing overbearing or floraly. They have a really nice cooling effect, which helps with eye bags and is super relaxing. I'm really enjoying using these before bed a few times a week. I highly recommend.

I saw green tea and didn't really look closely to see there was cucumber in them. I HATE cucumber. Like full blown despise it. It smells like bad, nasty soap. These REAK of cucumber. I can't stand them so I'll have to give them away

Used these once and see a difference with my dark under eye circles and creasing on side of eyes. Stayed in place for the full 45 min I had them on. Smell is so amazing!! Definitely recommended :) Will be purchasing more.
These will stay on as long as you want. My eyes feel and look so amazing afterwards. I've bought these 3 different times!
These eye patches smell amazing, suctioned to my face, no residue left behind.

Best under eye patches! They smell amazing, very cooling, and stay on. I usually have trouble with under eye patches but they really stay on nicely. After I take them off I feel hydrated and refreshed.
They aren't expensive & they work! These patches stay in place and hydrate your under eyes. I use them pretty regularly on top of my rigorous skin care routine to keep refreshed! And they smell nice!
I notice a difference when I wear these. Only down side is that they pull on my delicate undereye skin.

These under eye patches felt so soothing when first applying. They stayed in place well and were just the right amount of moisture. They stayed perfect for the suggested 30 minutes of wear. I used them before going to bed and woke up the next morning to just soft and hydrated under eyes … they had apparently worked so well that I got carded for drinks the night after use. I'm 33 and never get carded in my town. TALK ABOUT A WIN!!!

These patches stay on my eyes which is something I look for when buying eye masks. I always put them in the fridge before using them. Apply an eye cream to my under eyes and then put these on. I can wear them while I do homework and other things.

avis.titre: Love them ❤️ They work and live the smell too !
avis.texte: I've been using these for a week now and they work and smell great , my under eye looks healthier and not so much like I'm dying love them will be using them from now on !! 🥒

Product was cooling & soothing around the eyes; but I'm unsure if it made any difference at all, referring to the claims that it would reduce puffiness & darkness under the eyes. still a nice way to spend 30 minutes.

avis.titre: Pulls skin, feels dry and stiff
avis.texte: Once you put these on, they don't move so you can't really readjust. Because it has a felt back, it feels super stiff under the eyes to the point where it's uncomfortable if it's close to the lower lash line. When I removed it, it tugs and pulls the delicate skin. That can't be good!!!! It did not feeling hydrating at all.
These feel good, and they reduce my puffiness q little but not enough to justify rebuying them or even the half hour you need to leave them on for.

I got these for my mom. Her eyes are very dry and dark. I feel like it brightened her eyes so much more and hydrated the dry area. It's also very cooling and relaxing. She looks like a little panda lol. I buy most of my products from Earth Therapeutics, so I'm not surprised they're so great. I seen a comment saying they fall of easy and aren't good. It has a side where it sticks very easily and good to the face. They must've not used it correctly or got their grimy hands on that side.
These are great. They stay in place and smell like a spa treatment (cucumber and green tea).
Patches do not stay in place. Fall off very easily and irritated my eyes.
It was so refreshing and was so nice to use I think it made a little bit of a difference to my eye bags and it was so nice I would recommend

I tried using this product straight from the box, and having put a packet in the refrigerator overnight. There was no increase in benefits in refrigerating. The best thing is the wonderful cucumber scent. It is so fresh and clean. This product moisturizes the under eye area very well, and did not break out my sensitive skin. There was a slight depuffing under the eyes after use, but I was hoping for more. Still happy I tried it, as it feels like a spa treatment.

Unlike most patches that are very very juicy and slippery, these kinda stick to wherever you place them. Ofc they come off just as easily as they're placed. I leave mine in my beauty fridge so they are cold when I use them. Now I can use I patches over my eye moisturizer for an added boost without having to worry about the patches slipping off my face. I wish they came in larger packs. I'll definitely be buying more very soon!

avis.titre: I definitely would buy this product again love it.!!
avis.texte: I noticed after I took off patches I immediately saw the difference.
These depuff and soothe my eyes whenever I need it, great product!

I've used these three times and my eyes seem to be the same as without using the product. I bought two packs because they were on sale. Hopefully by then my under eye darkness and puffiness will have gone down some?? The reviews are great which is why I got them but not seeing so much of a difference.
I'm glad I discovered these .the pads are so refreshing and the cooling feeling helps feel your under eyes relaxed .
These patches help me look refreshed in the morning. They reduce puffiness and brighten the under-eye area. I love that they stay in place. I highly recommend these!

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to anyone who has puffiness.
avis.texte: It's quick & easy to use. It has a great smell. Very soothing & relaxing.

avis.titre: Nice to use in the morning on puffy eyes.
avis.texte: These were the first-ever under eye patches I've ever used, so I don't have much to compare to, but I thought these were nice and soothing on those mornings when I didn't get enough sleep. I have always had dark circles around my eyes, so they didn't really help with that, but they did seem to help the puffiness that I get from lack of sleep. These were also a nice shape that fit well under my eyes.
Love the instant cooling effect, and I can see a difference immediately after removing them. It temporarily brightens up my dark circles !

If I'm willing to take the time to write a review that means I really love the product lol these are awesome!!! they feel so good! they stay put when u apply them, they are not uncomfortable, and my under eye feels so good afterwards. I just started using them (3 applications) but can already see a difference!!! BUY THESE!!!! ;)
These eye patches are so cool! They are not sticky or messy and stay in place once you put them on. I feel like they really did make a difference after the first try. I love these!

i was actually surprised by how well these work. i'm in my late teens and have really bad eye bags, and i wore these for 30 mins before sleeping. when i took them off, the difference was very slight, but noticeable. it takes a few times of using them to really see a difference, especially if you have bad eye bags like me. don't expect instantly good results or you will be disappointed.

I honestly didn't expect much from these patches but I'm so glad I tried them! It made an immediate difference to my under eyes. I wish I could pinpoint exactly what ingredient actually worked for me because I've tried SO many products over the years that didn't do anything.

Skyn Iceland has had the eye patches to beat for years. For so long, I never found anything comparable. I saw these were pretty highly rated on other websites & forums, so decided to give them a try. Finally! A cheaper option that's seriously effective.

I actual leave these in the fridge so there nice and cold when I put them on. They work wonders, they take care of my fine lines and dark under eyes. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is cause it only comes with 4 in a box.

avis.titre: Good quick fix for under eyes that look tired
avis.texte: Love these eye patches and the collagen version as well. Both do a good job of making me look less tired and hydrate the skin around the under eye. Good price point for results and will buy again.
I will not buy this ever again it made my eyes puffy Wrinkly.

I have tried many things for my dark circles and these patches work extremely well, I would use them in the morning and leave them on for about 2 hours. I do wish there were more pairs in a box but I will definitely purchase again.

I bought these a year ago then started going thru a divorce. now I'm settled into my new home and while unpacking I found these and have been using for about two weeks at three times a week and the results are incredible. they have begun erasing a miserable six year marriage!
It actually feels so smooth and cool when you put in on and my eyes felt and looked less puffy after 30 minutes. It also smells really good and fresh, which is a plus.

avis.titre: Cooling, calming, and lovely cucumber scent!
avis.texte: I use these while my kids are napping. Easy to unwrap and apply, and I can still see (do chores, reading, etc.) while wearing which is a plus.
These have been my go to for a few years now .. please don't change
The patches feel nice and cool when you apply without refrigerating. Every time I use them my undereyes look so much brighter and soothed.

I really enjoyed this product! Stays put and has a nice, cooling feeling. It's a great dupe for Skyn ICELAND eye gels but not as expensive which is great! Feels nice when you chill them in the fridge for a few minutes before putting in your eyes.

I generally do not have sensitive eyes or skin. The first 2 times I used these it went fine. Cool and refreshing, puffiness significantly reduced. Smells great. Since then, every time I use them it is miserable. Eyes immediately burning, skin gets red and swollen within 1 to 2 minutes of placing them. Double checked instructions just to make sure I wasn't using them incorrectly and I was not. Just be careful if you have sensitive skin.

Use them as directions say and you will notice a change. These eye patches are the first to actually stay on !! & for the price That's a big plus for me and they're very cooling & refreshing under eyes feels and looks nice after💙 please don't ever stop making or don't raise the price lol
I actually use a good bit of products from this brand. I have always like them and also been satisfied. These I did notice a change with, just have to follow instructions and use as often as it says.

avis.titre: Did nothing for under eye circles or wrinkles
avis.texte: I've been using these twice a week for a month and have seen no improvements in my under eye circles or wrinkles. They did help with some minor puffiness one morning, but I usually don't have much trouble with puffy eyes.
First time using this eye patch. Have used others (like DHC which I also like) but this one works even better at reducing puffiness and dark circles.

36 yo... dont take care of myself well bc I'm too busy taking care of others. I've used clinique for years. I noticed in an anniversary pic just how much older my eyes are starting make me look!! I researched a couple different products. I originally wanted PTR gold patches but I cant afford that. I'm very happy with ET with green tea. My crow's feet are very minimal now. Under eye is so much more firm and less puffy. I read about some people complaining that they slip off. I put them on immediately after my shower and have had zero problems with slippage. I get dressed, blow dry my hair, eat dinner (work night shift), and then before I know it it's time to take them off. I dont write reviews, so me coming here is a big deal. I want other moms and women worrying about their skin to find something that makes them happy, even if just over some eye patches :)
Love these! Cool on the skin and leaves under eye area soft, bright, and refreshed. I use a few times a week and have seen a difference!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again. Worth the money
avis.texte: I use these every other day. I've read people use it twice a day but eye patches can be expensive. I notice the line that was not there before (!!) is softer. My skin looks smoother and the dark circles (from lack of sleep) is not as bad. The gel is very sticky and I like how it has a felt pad on it. The eye patches stick on. Well worth the money!
I really liked these. They're easy to use and aren't so saturated that they slide all over your face.
You just peel the plastic on the back and stick under your eyes and relax, there's no messy type of cream or nothing. They feel refreshing and come off so easily.
Love that they stay in place and do not fall off. I keep them on for about 30 mins.
this irritated my skin and left a weird residue. I didn't notice much else.
I keep going back to these under eye patches! Love the cooling and does reduce puffiness! I have tried several brands and these are my favorite!
Been a loyal buyer for years don't change the price and don't change the formula . I keep these on the fridge for a pick me up and you can see the the difference!
It works great !! I have used it in my boyfriend he has dark circles after 30 minutes you can see the difference!
Fragrance is too strong and leaves a weird crust under my eyes even after I put on a hydrating eye cream after love the collagen eye masks from this brand though.
These feel good to wear, but I don't think they have any lasting effects. I'm shocked by how many positive reviews there are...I didn't notice a lick of difference.
These work great and I love how cooling they feel after being in the fridge!
My skin is not sensitive what so ever and all it did was irritate my skin. The gel also isn't strong or feels like much cooling at all. I've used a few brands and this is one I won't purchase again.

I bought these just browsing through the k beauty section. I am so glad I picked these up!! When you place them down, they stay on.I have chronic dry eyes and allergies and these help so much. The ingredients offer a very cooling, soothing effect almost spa like. I use these while I'm getting ready and applying eyeshadow to help with any fallout OR just lounging around reading. They have other kinds I also am interested in trying too!

avis.titre: Great smell, feel, and helps skin
avis.texte: Recently started utilizing eye gels to reduce bags under eyes. These are my favorite so far. They have a great smell, very subtle green tea. They feel cool and refreshing when you first apply to skin and can leave on for quite some time (usually 30 minutes or so) without drying off and feeling like it's ripping off skin during removal. Highly recommend these.
Easy to use and works great! Only downfall is that it has to be left on eyes for 30 mins. So you will need to give yourself time to use.

Instead of trying fifty different undereye concealers, I decided to try hydrogel patches. Concealer never stuck to the darkest part of my undereye and the color never matched. But after using these 1x or 2x a week, I've definitely noticed a difference. My undereye is way smoother and way lighter! My lower lash line itches a bit when using them, but I think that's from the patch tugging, not irritation. Absolutely no residue left over and they peel off easily.
I bought this to try and help with my puffy eyes and it actually help reduce it a little bit. I will definitely purchase again.
I love these under eye patches. They have a refreshing scent, and actually bring down the puffiness! The fine lines under my eyes are less noticeable too! I love this product!
These were so useless; it was as if I had done nothing at all.

A life saver during allergy season! I'll wear these for an hour while doing my hair, and my under eyes are significantly less puffy and moisturized. They are a little irritating and itch a little, but everyone's skin is different and the benefit outweighs the mild discomfort. I'm a repeat buyer!
I absolutely love these! You don't have to keep them in the fridge for the cool sensation. They actually work, and they smell amazing!

avis.titre: Purchased more than once - yes, it's worth it!
avis.texte: I've tried several brand-name products that are designed similar to this one, and I have to say that for the price, these are totally worth it! I don't notice any visible difference after using them, but I honestly only use eye masks like these for relaxing. I don't expect visible results. The cucumber scent is relaxing, but not overwhelming. I've purchased them several times especially since they are usually part of a "Buy More Get More" sale, which makes them and even BETTER buy.

Was excited to try these and it qaant as great as I was hoping. I dont have super dark under circles and I was hoping this would help with refreshing my under eyes. Each time I took them off my eyes seemed darker even after a while. I'll finish the pack but wont be buying these again.
I don't feel that this product is effective. I prefer the Skyn brand version, which I think actually help with puffiness a little bit unlike these.
